worker_target_description: Experiment 1 replication of Caruso et al. (2008) Study 1: temporal location (past versus future) and monetary valuation in the self-relevant condition; supplementary hypothesis 1a. Matched by the original study reference, self-relevant monetary outcome, section 3.2 and supplementary hypothesis label, not input row order or numeric matching.
worker_notes: Identity assessment: supplied canonical text is the full primary accepted/in-press manuscript with supplementary materials, not an abstract-only parse or standalone preregistration. Title, all five authors (El Halabi, Chan, Tunca, Ziano, Feldman), Journal of Economic Psychology acceptance statement dated March 18, 2022, and supplied DOI header 10.1016/j.joep.2022.102509 match the neutral replication reference. The document includes methods, results, discussion and supplementary analyses; its final supplementary pages reproduce a preregistration, which was not substituted for the report. No PDF was supplied; no rendering or acquisition performed. Only n_r is assigned; all other fields are unassigned placeholders. N=213 is explicitly printed for the relevant self condition, not summed or inferred from degrees of freedom. N=423 is the combined self/other experiment sample and is not used for this target. Source inconsistency preserved: section 3.2 p. 13 prints t(421) = -0.22 for this Study 1 comparison, despite p. 8 explicitly describing the self-relevant subset as n=213; no N is inferred from this df and no df correction is made. Alternative supplementary samples n=202 (valuation threshold exclusion) and n=211 (3 SD exclusion) concern different analyses and are not merged with the primary full-sample target. Supplementary Table B explicitly labels the monetary judgment / temporal location effect hypothesis 1a, supporting correspondence to study_r 1A despite the manuscript using Experiment 1 / replication of Study 1 labels.
